phase_normalization_rule: Native card/flag is primary: G or CEA 0 means gas. Recognized state suffixes refine compatible non-gas cards and retain polymorph identity. Other parentheses are nomenclature. phase_as_published preserves a state suffix or the native token; conflicting state suffixes are recorded as ambiguities. Unsuffixed C and positive CEA flags remain C and CEA:<flag>.
comment_block: Co (cr,l) Cobalt Reference Element Input by B.McBride NASA ThermoBuild Note MB
JANAF pages 912-5.  Intermediate temps from Malcolm Chase. S and H-H2 values at 2000K and H-H2 value at 3900K do not round correctly.  Attempts were made to
adjust this, but nothing was found that would not affect the other data.
Adjustments in S were made at 700.100K and 1768.000K, and also in DELTAH so
that rounded values match table. An interval was added for 1394 - 1400 K on
10/21/91 because it was discovered that 1394 to 1768 interval resulted in
a very bad fit. Max Lst Sq Error Cp @ 1200 K 0.50%.
